narrowest_defensible_positioning: 基于近期解耦、连续分解与关系展开工作，探索特定分离约束对光谱空间联合响应的影响，并检验约束接口与内部组合训练能否带来无HR训练标签的自然场景收益。
what_would_change_the_decision: 若近期或历史先行工作已有同构机制，或普通内部训练、弱约束及同预算对照解释全部收益，则降级；若合理约束下机制与自然指标均重复成立，再扩大检索与验证后重新评估。
top_kill_shot_objections: Geometric separation does not imply loss of functional interaction.
Spectral-spatial factor multiplication, modulation, and synergy-aware disentanglement have strong prior art.
Weakening an artificially harmful penalty is not improvement over the original baseline.
Extra synthetic targets, capacity, or ordinary optimization may explain gains.
A constructed mixing prior does not establish natural-image identifiability or metric gains.
claims_to_qualify: Do not claim first multimodal synergy or conditional modulation.
Do not claim separation necessarily destroys interaction.
Do not claim a first physical quartet until closest physical synthesis and auxiliary-task work is fully checked.
Do not claim PSNR, RMSE, or SAM improvements; no new network was trained or evaluated.
Procedural targets supply an explicit mixing prior, not naturally observed HR labels.
Rating governs positioning, not empirical correctness or readiness.
Recent publications do not prove that decoupling harms reconstruction.
Projected separation and conditional local graphs are hypotheses, not established novel mechanisms.
No blanket unbiased-risk theorem is transferred from Equivariant Splitting.
Internal downscaled targets impose a scale-generalization assumption.
missing_prior_work: NQ1: Closest projected-separation and reconstruction-interface training methods need further systematic review.
NQ2: Closest factorial physical synthesis, null-space auxiliary targets and internal-training mechanisms remain unresolved.
NQ3: Complete IEEE texts and coupled posterior/degradation training pipelines have not been fully inspected.

review_independence.description: Same agent and project context; no independent second review pass.

selection_history.prior_failures: Generic modulation is strongly overlapped; no actual D2 empirical failures exist.

evidence_scope.code_availability: Public source access only; no runtime or reproduction verification.

next_step: Freeze protocol; diagnose actual functional effects under reasonable separation weights, then compare projection-interface and combination-training controls before claiming improvements.
